<!-- Generated by migration/generators/kind-reference.mjs from Vulnetix/config-schemas. Edit the schema, kind-notes.mjs or the generator, not this page. -->
Every config kind with a released schema, grouped by the part of Vulnetix it configures. All of them use `apiVersion: vulnetix.com/v1`. This page lists the 59 kinds in `config-schemas` v1.17.1.

| Status | Meaning | Kinds |
|---|---|---|
| Served | The config engine plans, applies and exports it. | 57 |
| Validate only | The server stores nothing for it. Validating and planning check a document; apply sends nothing. | 2 |
| Schema only | The schema is released and the engine does not serve it yet. | 0 |
| Planned | No schema yet. | 0 |

Each kind's page has its fields, a Minimal and an Advanced sample in YAML, HCL and CLI, its rules, how apply treats it, and its Terraform resource. To apply any of them, see [Apply](/platform-iac/cli/apply/); to manage them with Terraform or OpenTofu, see [Terraform and OpenTofu](/platform-iac/terraform/). Release history: [Schema releases](/platform-iac/schemas/releases/).

## Org

Who the organization is, who is in it, and how it is told things.

| Kind | Objects | Status | Terraform | What it declares |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`Organization`](/platform-iac/kinds/organization/) | one | Served | `vulnetix_organization` | The organisation's own settings: its display name, its company email domains and whether Drift protection is on. |
| [`Member`](/platform-iac/kinds/member/) | many | Served | `vulnetix_member` | A person in the organisation, by email address, with their role. |
| [`ServiceAccount`](/platform-iac/kinds/service-account/) | many | Served | `vulnetix_service_account` | A credential for CI that is not a person. |
| [`NotificationDefaults`](/platform-iac/kinds/notification-defaults/) | one | Served | `vulnetix_notification_defaults` | The organisation's default browser push notifications: which events are pushed to a person who has not chosen for themselves. |
